meaning:
ἀπο-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποβάλλω);
1. a throwing away, rejection: opposite to πρόσλημψις, Rom.11:15.
2. a losing, loss: Act.27:22.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
